title: Sinkamino Canonical Representation
description: Rectangular grid of white, black and given-square cells, plus arrow trails through cell centres. The player places squares; edge-connected squares form islands, each crossed by trails exactly once, and along each trail every island is the previous one's shape (same orientation) plus one square.

cells.description: m x n grid. 0 = white cell, 1 = black cell, 2 = given square.

arrows.description: Arrow trails. Each is an ordered list of [row, col] cells from tail to head; consecutive cells are orthogonally adjacent, and no cell is black.
